assumptions.statement: geometry/site_boundary.geojson and geometry/key_areas.geojson use provisional rough constraints from the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Area, ratio, land-use share, key-area shape, A0/A3 graphics, and HTML visuals are intake discussion materials only and must be recalculated after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, flood, fire, heritage, public-service, and implementation constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Building scale, FAR, height, demolition/renovation, road geometry, municipal systems, budget, and implementation claims remain conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.

assumptions.statement: Scenario operations require named municipal, platform, university, enterprise, and community operators before launch.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards include proposed accountability, KPI, human review, and exit clauses, but they are not confirmed implementation commitments.
